The manager will change the fair-value calculation frequency for the company's long-term debt from daily to monthly with effect from 10 November 2025 due to reduced market volatility; this change does not impact the debt-at-par NAV. The monthly update cadence may delay reflection of short-term interest-rate moves in the fair-value NAV, creating potential timing differences for investors.
